matching_image.title: Match the Image
matching_image.description: Remember and match familiar everyday images.

content.prompt: Which image did you just see?
Match the earlier image to its pair.
Which image appeared in the sequence?

family_quiz.title: Family Quiz
family_quiz.description: Identify familiar people from memory prompts.

content.prompt: Who is this family member?
Which family member is connected to this memory?
Identify the person from the family memory graph.

place_correctly.title: Place It Correctly
place_correctly.description: Place familiar objects in their correct positions.

content.prompt: Place the cup on the table.
Place the lamp beside the bed.
Place the key to the right of the book.

find_differences.title: Find the Differences
find_differences.description: Spot changes between two familiar scenes.

content.prompt: Find the one difference in the scene.
Find two differences in the scene.
Find three differences in the detailed scene.

sequence_pattern.title: Complete the Pattern
sequence_pattern.description: Discover the rule and complete a familiar sequence.

content.prompt: What comes next: 2, 4, 6, ?
What comes next: 3, 6, 12, ?
What comes next: 1, 4, 9, 16, ?

odd_one_out.title: Odd One Out
odd_one_out.description: Identify the item that does not belong.

content.prompt: Which one is different?
Which one is not a mode of transport?
Which one does not belong with the others?

number_compare.title: Number Compare
number_compare.description: Compare quantities in simple everyday situations.

content.prompt: Which number is greater: 7 or 4?
What is 8 + 5?
What is 24 divided by 3?

picture_recall.title: Picture Recall
picture_recall.description: Recall details from a briefly shown scene.

content.prompt: What color was the umbrella?
How many birds were in the garden?
Which object was closest to the window?

daily_routine.title: Daily Routine Recall
daily_routine.description: Remember the order of familiar daily activities.

content.prompt: What usually comes first in the morning?
Which activity came after breakfast?
Put the routine's final activity in place.
